exactSemantics: store.forecast is[] in Full Board; otherwise pending.forecast ?? game.incoming. During shower presentation, Core may already hold the following incoming array while the HUD must retain the arriving shower array.

showerCountdown.arriving is true when pending arrivals exist OR rainDue is deferred. It is not inferred from a trail animation callback. Progress is1 while arriving; normal advancement samples the existing deadline.
A contact can freeze advancement without pausing the round: advancing=false does not imply paused=true. Pause/background retain their existing remainder/grace and no-catch-up policy.

Next/Arriving label comes directly from countdown.arriving. Optional shower reader requires a non-arriving captured source whose forecast equals that game.incoming, plus current revalidation and busy gating.

Selection/reader sources are retired on existing contact, lifecycle, game/generation or displayed-forecast change. Presentation completion can refresh the displayed forecast without a new input generation.
Destination numbers are one-based mappings of each actual ordered entry. Never deduplicate repeated columns, replace IDs with array indices, or use animated positions to determine facts.
